newsitem.title: USA: Platinum to buy Georgia record company.
newsitem.headline: Platinum to buy Georgia record company.

text.p: Platinum Entertainment Inc. said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Intersound Inc. for about $24 million in cash and $5 million of convertible debentures.

Roswell, Ga.-based Intersound, one of the nation's largest independent record companies, focuses on most major music categories, including gospel, adult contemporary, country, urban, dance, classical and themed productions.

Intersound has its own proprietary distribution system, which allows the company to maintain control over the marketing and promotion of its products, selling and fulfilling its orders on a direct basis.
Downers Grove, Ill.-based Platinum produces, licenses, acquires, markets and distributes recorded music for a variety of music formats.

For the year ended April 30, Intersound had earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of $3.2 million on gross revenues of $33 million. On a proforma basis, revenues from the combined companies would have been about $58 million for the year ended May 31, 1996.

The deal is expected to close before the year ends, subject to due diligence and the securing of financing by Platinum of the cash portion of the purchase price. Platinum said it intends to get the financing through bank loans or a private placement.
Platinum's stock was unchanged at $9.25 on Nasdaq at midday.
